keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Hoffenheim 1. Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tim Lemperle with a through ball following a fast break.
Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Óscar Mingueza replaces Anan Khalaili.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Eddie Nketiah replaces Quinten Timber.
Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Honest Ahanor (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Adam Daghim replaces Tim Lemperle.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Darío Osorio replaces Jean-Philippe Mateta.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Honest Ahanor.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Bernardo replaces Alexander Prass.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Cajetan Lenz replaces Fisnik Asllani.
Second yellow card to Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Jykese Fields replaces Wouter Burger.
Goal! Crystal Palace 1, Hoffenheim 1. Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Second Half ends, Crystal Palace 1, Hoffenheim 1.
